implementationApproach.selectedApproach:
# AR-05B initial design

This is a version of the one canonical aggregate. Existing operational schemas stay legacy-strict. New APIs are inactive opt-in entrypoints for AR-06 and focused tests.

Domain API: `composedPageModelV1Schema`, `composedStorefrontSnapshotV1Schema`, `parseStorefrontSnapshotVersion(input: unknown)` in storefront-composition-version.ts. The parser returns legacy StorefrontSnapshot or structurally parsed ComposedStorefrontSnapshotV1; neither is semantic acceptance. Presence of compositionExtensionVersion selects dispatch: absent legacy, exactly 1.0.0 composed, other values reject. Composed pages have required exact AR-05A composition; uncomposed pages use the original page schema. Root requires at least one composed static/dynamic owner, rejects wrong nesting, and retains all common snapshot invariants.

`dynamicCommercePresentationAuthorityV2MaterialSchema`, `dynamicCommercePresentationAuthorityV2Schema`, `createDynamicCommercePresentationAuthorityV2`, `parseDynamicCommercePresentationVersion` in dynamic-commerce-composition-version.ts distinguish exact v1 and v2. V2 requires at least one composed archetype; original archetypes may coexist. Its fingerprint is `dynamic-commerce-presentation-v2-` plus canonicalValueFingerprint of complete normalized v2 material without its own authorityFingerprint. No fake v1 material is created. Current v1 normalization/fingerprints remain exact. Existing archetype refinements are reused through safeExtend; share original dynamic material shape, structural reference refiner and generically typed normalization functions without copying or changing their bodies.

Composed owner storage is strictly increasing code-unit section-id/slot-id order; serialized reads reject noncanonical arrays before transformations. Only explicit construction sorts cloned composed inventories. Uncomposed ordering is unchanged. Composition owns layout order and relationships. Existing root content normalization and canonical hash primitives remain unchanged; a type-only aggregate union and conditional root marker inclusion make identity cover composition/content without a new hot runtime import or recursive snapshot fingerprint.

Application API: `createComposedStorefrontCandidate(base: unknown, request: ComposedStorefrontCandidateRequest, resolveAuthority: StorefrontCompositionAuthorityResolver)` and `validateComposedStorefrontSnapshot(input: unknown, resolveAuthority: StorefrontCompositionAuthorityResolver)`. Request contains expectedBase {id, revision, contentFingerprint}, successor {id, revision, projectId, catalogueRef, createdAt, createdBy}, and bounded assignments of exact A PageBlueprintCompositionSelection values. Exact names are locked here. Revalidate expected base id/revision/content fingerprint; require distinct successor id, revision exactly base+1, unchanged project/catalogue, strictly valid existing timestamp/createdBy conventions. No revision allocator, repository write or draft-pointer mutation.

The resolver receives the frozen actual owner identity and selection/retained composition context and supplies only trusted candidate, componentDefinitions, support and requiredAssetRoleCapacityEvidence (A authority without owner). It cannot replace the owner. Resolve all owner identities from the strictly parsed containing snapshot, reject duplicates/missing/foreign/route-instance targets. Remove only known composition from an already parsed owner in a private validation view, never return a downgraded snapshot. Use A's compiler for explicit selections and its same validateCompiledPageBlueprintComposition for attachment/read, including all existing composed owners not selected in the update. Validate everything before returning a deeply immutable AcceptedComposedStorefrontSnapshotV1 branded result. Fail deterministically without partial acceptance or source mutation.

Preserve truthful pageFamily and profile provenance: A's family/type/version/context checks remain; static profile id/version must belong to getPageFamilyDefinition's existing allowedProfileReferences, without validating old slot/layout order as a second layout authority. Dynamic profile id/version must be allowed for every supported family and its exact retained profile fingerprint must equal current materializeExecutablePageBlueprint with the existing registered commercial profile and trusted component definitions. Reuse registered profile/materializer functions, do not duplicate schemas or import current renderer validation. Preserve shared-frame/context/capability/default/reference invariants. Profile provenance does not select composed order, and no fake v2 profile is invented.

For a collection/search archetype, validate the matching candidate family context first, then every remaining actual supportedContexts entry before acceptance. A requires one exact candidate family per context: a two-context archetype is structurally representable but cannot currently semantically accept one single-family composition for both. Extra realization support alone does not remove this contract limitation. Today's actual collection/search/PDP inventories still fail their original required-region/cardinality/anatomy rule before any later context mismatch. Record this explicitly in AR-06 handoff; do not fabricate a second candidate, presentation or option state, or alter existing contexts. Static acceptance may coexist with unchanged v1 dynamic authority.

Legacy guards: page/snapshot/repository/history/proposal/publish validation remain their existing strict authorities. Add page validation at both Puck entrypoints before projection/reconstruction. In registry createStorefrontPagePaths (also reached by createStorefrontRenderContext), reject own extension marker and validate actual pages/dynamic authority through existing strict legacy schemas before deriving paths; no new codec import, recursive merchant-content scan or allowComposition flag. Existing v1 valid results must remain identical.

Historical closure: archive exact storefront.ts and canonical-storefront.ts base bytes with the two runbook hashes; extend only their closed retained-source reader/fixture records and A07 explicit caller pins. A10A/A10C lookup/chain remain unchanged. One existing current assertion file is selected: tests/integration/ar-05a-composition-authority.test.ts exact inactive-consumer list may add all three new B modules only, retaining the original three-module runtime closure and active-root bans; new B tests independently cover the B domain/binder closure. Other source guards stay unchanged unless an actual separately reviewed initial preflight finding establishes an allowed maintenance need before locking.

Eight production paths, target1000/hard1500 production additions, total handwritten4500 additions, optional fixture250lines. No A module changes. Reject duplicate schema trees, legacy stripping/coercion, fake dynamic positives, profile-as-layout fallback and default activation. Parent AR-05 closure is contingent on original T01/T02 representation/version acceptance; AR-06 executable rendering/Puck/save/history/publication and dynamic realization remain unstarted.
